ingredients.foodName: Orge perlée, bouilli/cuite à l'eau, sans sel ajouté

steps: Steam the whiting for 8-10 min.
Cook the pearl barley in water according to the package instructions.
Wilt the spinach in a pan, and serve it all together.

recipes.name: Chickpea, Artichoke & Tomato Salad
recipes.description: Chickpeas with artichoke hearts and fresh tomatoes: a fiber-rich plant-based lunch.
steps: Drain the chickpeas and artichoke hearts.
Mix with the diced tomato.
Drizzle with olive oil before serving.

recipes.name: Grilled Tofu, Wild Rice & Roasted Butternut Squash
recipes.description: Pan-browned tofu with wild rice and roasted butternut squash: a complete, autumnal plant-based lunch.

ingredients.foodName: Riz sauvage, cuit, sans sel ajouté
Courge butternut (doubeurre), chair sans peau, cuite

steps: Slice the tofu and brown it in a pan for 5-6 min on each side.
Cook the wild rice in water according to the package instructions.
Serve with the oven-roasted butternut squash and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.name: Roasted Sea Bream, Quinoa & Zucchini
recipes.description: Oven-roasted sea bream with quinoa and melting zucchini: a light lunch, rich in marine protein.

ingredients.foodName: Dorade grise ou daurade grise ou griset, rôtie/cuite au four
Quinoa, bouilli/cuit à l'eau, sans sel ajouté

steps: Roast the sea bream in the oven for 15-18 min at 180°C (350°F).
Cook the quinoa in water.
Cook the zucchini down in a pan in olive oil, and serve together.

recipes.name: Plain Mussels, Basmati Rice & Parsley
recipes.description: Mussels with basmati rice, parsley, and lemon: simple, briny, rich in iron and vitamin B12.

ingredients.foodName: Riz basmati, cuit, sans sel ajouté
Citron, chair sans peau, sans pépins, cru

steps: Cook the basmati rice in water.
Warm the mussels if needed.
Assemble, sprinkle with chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.name: Duck Breast, Roasted Pumpkin & Green Beans
recipes.description: Grilled duck breast with roasted pumpkin and green beans: an autumn dinner rich in iron and beta-carotene.
steps: Sear the duck breast skin-side down, then flesh-side, to your preferred doneness.
Roast the pumpkin in the oven for 20-25 min at 200°C (400°F).
Serve with the steamed green beans.

recipes.name: Pollock, Parsnip Purée & Broccoli
recipes.description: Cooked pollock with a parsnip purée and steamed broccoli: a light, easy-to-digest dinner, rich in potassium.
steps: Cook the pollock, steamed or pan-fried.
Mash the cooked parsnip with a drizzle of olive oil for a purée texture.
Steam the broccoli, and serve it all together.

recipes.name: Pork Tenderloin, Sweet Potato & Spinach
recipes.description: Pork tenderloin with sweet potato and wilted spinach: a lean, protein-rich dinner.
steps: Cook the pork tenderloin in a pan or the oven until fully cooked through.
Steam or boil the sweet potato.
Wilt the spinach in a pan, and serve it all together.

recipes.name: Browned Tofu, Roasted Butternut Squash & Spinach
recipes.description: Pan-browned tofu with roasted butternut squash and wilted spinach: a complete, comforting plant-based dinner.

ingredients.foodName: Courge butternut (doubeurre), chair sans peau, cuite

steps: Cut the tofu into cubes and brown it in a pan for 5-6 min in olive oil.
Roast the butternut squash in the oven for 20-25 min at 200°C (400°F).
Wilt the spinach in a pan, and serve it all together.

recipes.name: Trout, Pearl Barley & Asparagus
recipes.description: Oven-roasted trout with pearl barley and green asparagus: an easy-to-digest dinner, rich in omega-3s.

ingredients.foodName: Truite arc en ciel, élevage, rôtie/cuite au four
Orge perlée, bouilli/cuite à l'eau, sans sel ajouté

steps: Roast the trout in the oven for 15-18 min at 180°C (350°F).
Cook the pearl barley in water according to the package instructions.
Steam the asparagus, and serve it all together.

recipes.name: Grilled Lamb, Bulgur & Artichokes
recipes.description: Grilled leg of lamb with bulgur and artichoke hearts: a generous dinner, rich in iron.

ingredients.foodName: Boulgour de blé, cuit, sans sel ajouté

steps: Pan-grill the leg of lamb to your preferred doneness.
Cook the bulgur according to the package instructions.
Warm the artichoke hearts, and serve it all with a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.name: Roasted Sea Bream, Parsnip & Asparagus
recipes.description: Oven-roasted sea bream with a parsnip purée and asparagus: a light dinner, rich in minerals.

ingredients.foodName: Dorade grise ou daurade grise ou griset, rôtie/cuite au four

steps: Roast the sea bream in the oven for 15-18 min at 180°C (350°F).
Mash the cooked parsnip with a drizzle of olive oil for a purée texture.
Steam the asparagus, and serve it all together.

recipes.name: Quark, Peach & Walnuts
recipes.description: Quark with diced peach and walnut halves: a fresh, filling snack.

ingredients.foodName: Pêche, chair sans peau, sans noyau, crue (aliment moyen)

steps: Pour the quark into a bowl.
Dice the peach and add it in.
Sprinkle with walnut halves.

recipes.name: Artichoke Hummus & Vegetable Sticks
recipes.description: Artichoke hearts mashed with olive oil and lemon, with vegetable sticks: an original plant-based snack.

ingredients.foodName: Citron, chair sans peau, sans pépins, cru

steps: Blend the artichoke hearts with the olive oil and lemon until creamy.
Cut the carrot and cucumber into sticks.
Serve together for dipping.

recipes.name: Dates & Pistachios
recipes.description: A few pitted dates with crushed pistachios: a snack dense in energy and healthy minerals.

ingredients.foodName: Datte, chair et peau, sans noyau, sèche

steps: Pit the dates if needed.
Serve them with the crushed pistachios.
Enjoy, alternating between the two.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt & Raspberries
recipes.description: Plain Greek yogurt with fresh raspberries: simple, creamy, rich in antioxidants.

ingredients.foodName: Yaourt à la grecque nature, au lait de brebis

steps: Pour the Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Add the fresh raspberries.
Enjoy right away.

recipes.name: Fresh Orange Juice & Crispbread
recipes.description: Freshly squeezed orange juice with two crispbreads: hydration and quick carbohydrates before exercise.

ingredients.foodName: Orange, chair sans peau, sans pépins, crue

steps: Squeeze the oranges to get the juice.
Serve it with the crispbreads.
Enjoy 30-45 min before training.

recipes.name: Basmati Rice & Applesauce
recipes.description: A small portion of warm basmati rice with applesauce: simple carbohydrates, very easy to digest, before your session.

ingredients.foodName: Riz basmati, cuit, sans sel ajouté

steps: Gently warm the basmati rice if needed.
Serve it with the applesauce.
Enjoy 30-45 min before exercise.

recipes.name: Marinated Tempeh, Wild Rice & Green Beans
recipes.description: Pan-seared tempeh with wild rice and green beans: a complete, fragrant plant-based lunch.

ingredients.foodName: Riz sauvage, cuit, sans sel ajouté

steps: Brown the tempeh in a pan for 4-5 min on each side.
Cook the wild rice in water according to the package instructions.
Serve with the steamed green beans and a drizzle of rapeseed (canola) oil.

recipes.name: Chickpea, Sweet Potato & Spinach Curry
recipes.description: A gentle, comforting curry: chickpeas bring fiber and plant protein, sweet potato its beta-carotene, coconut milk a creamy, dairy-free texture.
steps: Heat the olive oil, add the turmeric and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the chickpeas, sweet potato and coconut milk, simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then serve hot.

recipes.name: Marinated Tempeh, Brown Rice & Broccoli Bowl
recipes.description: Tempeh is an excellent source of fermented plant protein, easier to digest than plain tofu — paired with brown rice and broccoli for a complete, satisfying bowl.

ingredients.foodName: Riz complet, cuit, sans sel ajouté

steps: Slice the tempeh and pan-fry in olive oil, 3-4 minutes per side until golden.
Drizzle with soy sauce at the end of cooking.
Serve over the brown rice with steamed broccoli and grated carrot.

recipes.name: Bulgur, Chickpea & Grilled Vegetable Salad
recipes.description: A filling Mediterranean salad: bulgur and chickpeas together form a complete plant protein, while the grilled vegetables and lemon add freshness and vitamin C.

ingredients.foodName: Boulgour de blé, cuit, sans sel ajouté
Citron, chair sans peau, sans pépins, cru

steps: Mix the cooked bulgur with the chickpeas.
Add the grilled pepper and courgette.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, toss and serve.

recipes.name: Smoked Tofu, Quinoa & Avocado Buddha Bowl
recipes.description: Quinoa is one of the few plant sources of complete protein — paired with smoked tofu and avocado for healthy fats, this bowl checks every box.

ingredients.foodName: Quinoa, bouilli/cuit à l'eau, sans sel ajouté
Avocat, chair sans peau, sans noyau, cru

steps: Arrange the cooked quinoa at the bottom of the bowl.
Add the diced smoked tofu, grated carrot and raw spinach.
Finish with sliced avocado and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.name: Red Lentil Dahl, Spinach & Coconut Milk
recipes.description: Red lentils cook quickly and are rich in plant-based iron — turmeric and coconut milk turn this into a comforting dish, with no meat or dairy.
steps: Sauté the sliced onion in olive oil with the turmeric.
Add the lentils and coconut milk, simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then serve.

recipes.name: Chili Sin Carne, Kidney Beans & Peppers
recipes.description: A plant-based take on classic chili: red kidney beans bring fiber and protein, without losing any of the heartiness.

ingredients.foodName: Tomate, pelée, appertisée, au jus, non égouttée

steps: Sauté the onion in olive oil.
Add the kidney beans, tomato and pepper, simmer for 10 minutes.
Season and serve hot.

recipes.name: Tofu, Mushroom & Brown Rice Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Tofu soaks up the flavors of garlic and ginger as it cooks — a simple stir-fry, rich in plant protein and fiber thanks to the brown rice.

ingredients.foodName: Champignon de Paris ou champignon de couche, sauté/poêlé, sans matière grasse
Riz complet, cuit, sans sel ajouté

steps: Brown the diced tofu in olive oil.
Add the mushrooms, garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Serve over the hot brown rice.

recipes.name: Roasted Eggplant, Chickpea & Coconut Curry
recipes.description: Roasted eggplant turns tender and soaks up the spices — paired with chickpeas and coconut milk for a creamy, nourishing curry.

ingredients.foodName: Aubergine, chair et peau, rôtie/cuite au four

steps: Sauté the onion in olive oil with the turmeric.
Add the roasted eggplant, chickpeas and coconut milk, simmer for 5 minutes.
Season and serve hot.

recipes.name: Protein overnight oats, blueberries & chia
recipes.description: Made the night before in 3 minutes: the oats soak overnight, while skyr and whey turn it into a high-protein breakfast that keeps you going until lunch.

ingredients.foodName: Spécialité laitière riche en protéines, nature
Whey (protéine de lactosérum), poudre, boisson protéinée

steps: In a jar, mix the oats, whey and chia seeds.
Add the skyr and milk, stir well, close and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, top with blueberries. Eat cold, or warmed for 1 minute.

recipes.name: Protein pancakes, banana & blueberries
recipes.description: Fluffy pancakes with no flour or added sugar: oats, banana, eggs and whey for an indulgent yet high-protein breakfast.

ingredients.foodName: Whey (protéine de lactosérum), poudre, boisson protéinée

steps: Blend the oats, banana, egg, egg whites and whey into a smooth batter.
Lightly oil a hot pan, pour small ladles of batter and cook 1–2 minutes per side.
Serve with the blueberries.

recipes.name: Egg & egg-white omelette, spinach & wholemeal toast
recipes.description: Whole eggs plus whites keep the omelette's flavour while boosting protein; spinach and wholemeal bread add fibre, iron and magnesium.

ingredients.foodName: Pain complet ou intégral (à la farine T150)

steps: Beat the eggs and egg whites with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Wilt the spinach for 1 minute in the oiled pan, pour in the eggs and cook over medium heat.
Fold the omelette and serve with the toasted wholemeal bread.

recipes.name: Skyr bowl, strawberries, almonds & pumpkin seeds
recipes.description: A bowl ready in 2 minutes: skyr brings most of the protein, strawberries the vitamin C, almonds and pumpkin seeds magnesium and zinc.

ingredients.foodName: Spécialité laitière riche en protéines, nature
Amande, avec peau, sans sel ajouté

steps: Pour the skyr into a bowl.
Add the sliced strawberries, crushed almonds and pumpkin seeds.
Finish with a drizzle of honey.

recipes.name: Wholemeal toast, scrambled eggs & smoked salmon
recipes.description: A balanced take on brunch: eggs and smoked salmon for protein and omega-3, wholemeal bread for slow-release carbs.

ingredients.foodName: Pain complet ou intégral (à la farine T150)

steps: Toast the wholemeal bread.
Scramble the eggs over low heat, stirring constantly; take off the heat while still creamy.
Spoon the eggs onto the toast, add the smoked salmon, rocket and a few drops of lemon.

recipes.name: Banana & peanut butter protein shake
recipes.description: Ideal after training: milk and whey protein for muscle recovery, banana carbs to refill glycogen.

ingredients.foodName: Whey (protéine de lactosérum), poudre, boisson protéinée
Beurre de cacahuète ou pâte d'arachide

steps: Put all the ingredients in a blender.
Blend for 30 seconds until smooth.
Drink within an hour after your session.

recipes.name: Skyr, blueberries & walnuts
recipes.description: A simple, filling snack: skyr for protein, blueberries for polyphenols, walnuts for plant omega-3.

ingredients.foodName: Spécialité laitière riche en protéines, nature

steps: Pour the skyr into a bowl.
Add the blueberries and the crushed walnuts.

recipes.name: Rice cakes, tuna & cucumber
recipes.description: A light, high-protein savoury snack, ready in 2 minutes from pantry staples.
steps: Drain the tuna and season with a few drops of lemon.
Spread it over the rice cakes.
Top with cucumber slices.

recipes.name: Homemade recovery chocolate milk
recipes.description: Chocolate milk is one of the most studied recovery drinks: it combines protein, carbs, fluid and electrolytes after exercise.

ingredients.foodName: Cacao, sans sucres ajoutés, poudre soluble

steps: Warm the milk (or keep it cold).
Add the cocoa and honey, whisk or blend for a few seconds.

recipes.name: Salmon poke bowl, rice, avocado & mango
recipes.description: A homemade poke bowl: raw salmon for protein and omega-3, rice for energy, avocado, mango and cucumber for freshness.

ingredients.foodName: Riz blanc, cuit, sans sel ajouté
Avocat, chair sans peau, sans noyau, cru
Mangue, chair sans peau, sans noyau, crue

steps: Dice the salmon (very fresh, sashimi grade) and drizzle with soy sauce.
Put the rice in a bowl, then the salmon, sliced avocado, mango and cucumber.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Tuna niçoise salad
recipes.description: The Mediterranean classic: tuna, egg, green beans, tomatoes, potatoes and olives with an olive oil dressing.

ingredients.foodName: Pomme de terre, bouillie/cuite à l'eau

steps: Arrange the lettuce, tomato wedges, green beans and warm sliced potatoes.
Add the flaked tuna, the hard-boiled egg in quarters and the olives.
Dress with olive oil and lemon.

recipes.name: Chili con carne, kidney beans & brown rice
recipes.description: A hearty, balanced chili: 5% fat ground beef, fibre-rich kidney beans, tomatoes and pepper, spiced with cumin and paprika.

ingredients.foodName: Riz complet, cuit, sans sel ajouté

steps: Sauté the sliced onion and pepper in the oil, add the ground beef and brown it.
Add the tomatoes, cumin and paprika and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the kidney beans 5 minutes before the end and serve with the brown rice.

recipes.name: Shakshuka with peppers & wholemeal bread
recipes.description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato-pepper sauce: a complete, colourful and comforting dish, ready in 20 minutes.

ingredients.foodName: Pain complet ou intégral (à la farine T150)

steps: Sauté the onion, garlic and pepper in the oil for 5 minutes, add the cumin.
Pour in the tomatoes, reduce for 8 minutes, then make wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook 5–6 minutes over low heat. Sprinkle with parsley, serve with wholemeal bread.

recipes.name: Ratatouille, chicken breast & quinoa
recipes.description: Provençal ratatouille with grilled chicken and quinoa: a dinner packed with vegetables, protein and fibre.

ingredients.foodName: Quinoa, bouilli/cuit à l'eau, sans sel ajouté

steps: Sauté the onion in olive oil, add the diced zucchini, eggplant and pepper.
Add the tomatoes and herbes de Provence and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve with the sliced grilled chicken and the quinoa.

recipes.name: Chicken wrap, crunchy veg & herbed fromage blanc
recipes.description: The take-away lunch: grilled chicken, crunchy vegetables and a fromage blanc-chive sauce much lighter than mayonnaise.

ingredients.foodName: Tortilla souple (à garnir), à base de blé

steps: Mix the fromage blanc with the chopped chives, season.
Spread the sauce on the tortilla, add lettuce, tomato, grated carrot and sliced chicken.
Roll tightly and cut in half.

recipes.name: Lentil bolognese & whole wheat pasta
recipes.description: All the comfort of a bolognese, plant-based: lentils replace the meat and bring protein, iron and fibre.

ingredients.foodName: Pâtes sèches, au blé complet, cuites, sans sel ajouté

steps: Sauté the onion, garlic and finely diced carrot in olive oil.
Add the tomatoes, herbs and cooked lentils and simmer for 15 minutes.
Toss with the cooked whole wheat pasta.

recipes.name: Baked salmon, potatoes & green beans
recipes.description: A simple, complete dinner: salmon for omega-3 and vitamin D, potatoes for potassium, green beans for fibre.

ingredients.foodName: Pomme de terre, rôtie/cuite au four

steps: Roast the potato chunks for 25 minutes at 200 °C with a drizzle of oil.
Add the salmon fillet for the last 12 minutes.
Serve with the green beans, parsley and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.name: Greek salad with chicken
recipes.description: Cucumber, tomatoes, olives, red onion and feta with grilled chicken: a low-carb yet very filling salad.

ingredients.foodName: Feta, au lait de brebis 70% minimum et lait de chèvre 30% maximum

steps: Chop the cucumber, tomatoes and red onion.
Add the lettuce, olives, crumbled feta and sliced chicken.
Drizzle with olive oil and a pinch of oregano or herbs.

recipes.name: Tofu bowl, peanut sauce & crunchy vegetables
recipes.description: A colourful plant-based bowl: golden tofu, brown rice, red cabbage, carrot and broccoli, topped with a peanut-soy-lime sauce.

ingredients.foodName: Riz complet, cuit, sans sel ajouté
Beurre de cacahuète ou pâte d'arachide
Jus de citron vert, pur jus

steps: Pan-fry the tofu cubes until golden.
Mix the peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice and a little hot water.
Arrange rice, vegetables and tofu in a bowl, pour over the sauce and sprinkle with sesame.

recipes.name: Salmon fillet, garlic spinach & avocado
recipes.description: A low-carb dinner rich in healthy fats: salmon, avocado and spinach, ready in 15 minutes.

ingredients.foodName: Avocat, chair sans peau, sans noyau, cru

steps: Sear the salmon fillet 4 minutes per side.
Sauté the sliced garlic in the oil, add the spinach and wilt for 2 minutes.
Serve with the sliced avocado and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.name: Chicken, zucchini & mushrooms in olive oil
recipes.description: A quick low-carb, high-protein stir-fry flavoured with garlic and herbes de Provence.

ingredients.foodName: Champignon de Paris ou champignon de couche, sauté/poêlé, sans matière grasse

steps: Brown the chicken strips in the olive oil.
Add the sliced zucchini, mushrooms and garlic and cook for 8 minutes.
Season with herbes de Provence, salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Tempeh, quinoa, broccoli & soy-ginger sauce
recipes.description: Tempeh, a fermented soy food, is one of the most complete plant proteins: with quinoa it makes a high-protein plant-based lunch.

ingredients.foodName: Quinoa, bouilli/cuit à l'eau, sans sel ajouté

steps: Slice the tempeh and pan-fry it in the oil until golden.
Deglaze with the soy sauce and grated ginger.
Serve with the quinoa and steamed broccoli, sprinkle with sesame.

recipes.name: Light chicken curry with coconut milk & basmati rice
recipes.description: A mild, fragrant curry, lighter on coconut milk and boosted with spinach, served with basmati rice.

ingredients.foodName: Riz basmati, cuit, sans sel ajouté

steps: Sauté the onion in the oil, add the turmeric and ginger.
Add the chicken pieces, tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir in the spinach 2 minutes before the end and serve with the basmati rice.

recipes.name: Plant-based protein porridge, banana & peanut butter
recipes.description: A 100% plant-based, high-protein porridge: soy drink and soy protein, banana for sweetness, peanut butter for indulgence.

ingredients.foodName: Boisson au soja, nature, non enrichie, préemballée
Protéine de soja, isolat, poudre, nature
Beurre de cacahuète ou pâte d'arachide

steps: Heat the oats in the soy drink for 4 minutes, stirring.
Off the heat, stir in the soy protein.
Top with sliced banana and the peanut butter.
